name: Fantastic Contraption 2
summary: Fantastic Contraption 2 is the sequel to the original Flash hit; Fantastic Contraption. Developed in response to fan requests, Fantastic Contraption 2 contains the anticipated features of magnets, moving platforms, and the new integrated badge system. Users will also be able to conquer 60 new levels; master linking chains, and build creative contraptions of their own using the new Level Editor.
